verdict.rationale: Supermemory auto-syncs connectors (Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, GitHub) via real-time webhooks and automatically extracts memories/updates user profiles as users interact, which constitutes some background automation, but there's no evidence of user-configurable scheduled or agentic automation workflows beyond passive ingestion/sync. Missing for 10: explicit support for user-defined autonomous agent workflows or scheduled tasks, and any hands-on evidence of these background processes running reliably unattended.
